description: This file is a test script for the 'time_budget_functions' module in a behavioral analysis project. It uses pytest to perform unit testing of the time budget analysis function, verifying its output with various input scenarios including different subjects, behaviors, modifiers, and time intervals. It also involves loading data from a JSON file and interacting with a database through 'db_functions'. The file defines multiple test cases within the 'Test_time_budget' class, each designed to test specific aspects or edge cases of the time budget analysis functionality.

classes.name: Test_time_budget
classes.description: A class containing multiple pytest test methods for testing the time_budget_analysis function with various scenarios.

methods.name: test_time_budget1(self)
methods.description: Tests basic time budget analysis for two subjects and two behaviors, verifying the output matches expected results.

methods.name: test_time_budget2(self)
methods.description: Tests time budget analysis focusing on a single behavior across two subjects.

methods.name: test_time_budget3(self)
methods.description: Tests analysis with a focal subject and multiple behaviors, including cases with 'NA' durations.

methods.name: test_time_budget4(self)
methods.description: Tests analysis with special 'UNPAIRED' duration values for a particular observation category.

methods.name: test_time_budget5(self)
methods.description: Tests analysis with modifiers for behaviors, including multiple modifier cases and edge durations.
